# Held-out predictions and additive traits

## Helper functions

```{r}
extract_prediction<-function(row){
  return(as.numeric(row[paste0("fold_", as.numeric(row["Fold"]))]))}


extract_additive_trait <- function(row, trait){
  row <- as.list(row)
  if (isTRUE(row$WT)) {
    return(0)
  } else {
    if (trait == "Abundance") {
      return(as.numeric(row[[ row$additive_trait_column_f ]]))
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(row[[ row$additive_trait_column_a ]]))
    }
  }
}
```

## Predicted fitness

```{r}
predicted_phenotypes[, predicted_fitness := apply(.SD, 1, extract_prediction), .SDcols = colnames(predicted_phenotypes)]
```

## Additive traits

```{r}
predicted_phenotypes[,additive_trait_column_f := paste0("fold_", Fold, "_additive_trait0")]
  predicted_phenotypes[,additive_trait_column_a := paste0("fold_", Fold, "_additive_trait1")]
  predicted_phenotypes[, additive_trait_f := as.numeric(apply(.SD, 1, extract_additive_trait, "Abundance"))]
  predicted_phenotypes[, additive_trait_a := as.numeric(apply(.SD, 1, extract_additive_trait, "Activity"))]

setnames(predicted_phenotypes, "fitness", "observed_fitness")
```

# Observed vs predicted fitness

## Abundance
```{r}
p_obs_vs_pred_fold<-ggplot(predicted_phenotypes[Abundance==1], aes(y = observed_fitness, x = predicted_fitness)) +
  geom_pointdensity(size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_viridis(option = "magma", begin = 0.05, end = 0.85, guide = "none")+
  stat_cor(aes(label = ..r.label..),size=5,col="black",label.x.npc = "left",label.y.npc ="top")+
  facet_wrap(~factor(kinase, levels=kinases),ncol=7,scales="free",labeller = lab_kinase)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm",size=0.5)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Folding",
    y = "Observed Fitness",
    x = "Predicted Fitness"
  )

ggsave(p_obs_vs_pred_fold, filename = paste0(output_dir_figS, "FigS2A_obs_vs_pred_folding", format_img), height = 3.5, width = 15)

p_obs_vs_pred_fold_zak<-ggplot(predicted_phenotypes[Abundance==1&kinase=="ZAK"][, panel := "abundance"], aes(y = observed_fitness, x = predicted_fitness)) +
  geom_pointdensity(size = 0.5)+
  scale_color_viridis(option = "magma", begin = 0.05, end = 0.85, guide = "none")+
  stat_cor(aes(label = ..r.label..),size=5,col="black",label.x.npc = "left",label.y.npc ="top")+
  geom_smooth(method="lm",size=0.5)+
  facet_wrap(~panel)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))+
  labs(
    y = "Observed Fitness",
    x = "Predicted Fitness"
  )+ylim(-1,0.5)

```

# Activity fitness vs ddGf and ddGa (3D)

```{r}
plot_landscape_smooth <- function(
  dt,               
  kin,               
  num_grid = 15      
){
  dt_activity <- dt[Abundance == 0 & kinase == kin,
                    .(aa_seq, additive_trait_a, observed_fitness, predicted_fitness)]
  dt_folding <- dt[Abundance == 1 & kinase == kin,
                   .(aa_seq, additive_trait_f)]

  dt_merged <- merge(dt_activity, dt_folding, by = "aa_seq")

  dt_clean <- na.omit(dt_merged)
  dt_clean <- dt_clean[is.finite(additive_trait_f) &
                       is.finite(additive_trait_a) &
                       is.finite(predicted_fitness)]

  if(nrow(dt_clean) < 10) stop("Not enough data points.")

  x_seq <- seq(min(dt_clean$additive_trait_f), max(dt_clean$additive_trait_f), length = num_grid)
  y_seq <- seq(min(dt_clean$additive_trait_a), max(dt_clean$additive_trait_a), length = num_grid)
  grid_df <- expand.grid(additive_trait_f = x_seq, additive_trait_a = y_seq)

  loess_model <- loess(predicted_fitness ~ additive_trait_f * additive_trait_a,
                       data = dt_clean, span = 0.5)

  grid_z <- predict(loess_model, newdata = grid_df)


  z_matrix <- matrix(grid_z, nrow = num_grid, ncol = num_grid)


  plot3D::persp3D(
    x = x_seq,
    y = y_seq,
    z = z_matrix,

    color = "white", alpha = 0,
    border = "red", lwd = 0.5,
    colkey = FALSE,
    phi = 15, theta = 70,
    r = 2, shade = 0.4, axes = TRUE, scale = TRUE, box = T,
  nticks = 5,
  tck = -0.01,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "",
    zlab = "",
    ticktype = "detailed"
  )

  plot3D::scatter3D(
    x = dt_clean$additive_trait_f,
    y = dt_clean$additive_trait_a,
    z = dt_clean$observed_fitness,
    add = TRUE,
    col = alpha("black", 0.15), pch = 19, cex = 0.2
  )
}
graphics.off()

png(filename = paste0(output_dir_fig, "Fig1J_3D_surface", format_img),
    width = 4, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "transparent")
plot_landscape_smooth(dt = predicted_phenotypes, kin = "ZAK")
dev.off()
```

# Double-mutant prediction accuracy

```{r reported_attenuation}
if (file.exists(paste0(results_newdata, "all_data.Rdata"))) {
  .e <- new.env(); load(paste0(results_newdata, "all_data.Rdata"), envir = .e)
  ad <- data.table::as.data.table(.e$all_doubles)
  rel <- ad[Nham_aa == 2, {
    r12 <- cor(fitness1_uncorr, fitness2_uncorr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    r13 <- cor(fitness1_uncorr, fitness3_uncorr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    r23 <- cor(fitness2_uncorr, fitness3_uncorr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    .(reliability = median(c(r12, r13, r23)))
  }, by = .(kinase, assay)]
  rel[, assay := fifelse(assay == "abundance", "Abundance", "Activity")]

  robs <- rbind(
    predicted_phenotypes[Nham_aa == 2 & Abundance == 1,
      .(assay = "Abundance", r_obs = cor(observed_fitness, predicted_fitness, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")), by = kinase],
    predicted_phenotypes[Nham_aa == 2 & Activity == 1,
      .(assay = "Activity",  r_obs = cor(observed_fitness, predicted_fitness, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")), by = kinase])

  att <- merge(robs, rel, by = c("kinase", "assay"), all.x = TRUE)
  att[, r_corrected := r_obs / sqrt(reliability)]
  cat("== Double-mutant prediction: observed r, replicate reliability, attenuation-corrected r ==\n")
  print(att[order(assay, kinase)])
  medn <- att[, .(median_r_observed  = round(median(r_obs, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
                  median_r_corrected = round(median(r_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), 3)), by = assay]
  cat("== Median across kinases (observed r: all kinases; corrected r: SRC excluded) ==\n")
  print(medn)
}
```
